notes: Node (x,y,z) are the real callout locations returned by valorant-api for Ascent.

Adjacency, edge geometry, plant polygons, line-of-sight pairs and sound links are hand-authored approximations of Ascent's layout. No collision mesh or navmesh was available, so these are NOT measured values.
Google Drive Blender maps (Handoff section 9.1) were not downloaded in this environment; see docs/research/spatial-sources.md.

movement.note: run 6.75 m/s is the documented VALORANT base move speed; walk (shift) ~3.4 m/s is approximate. Both are provenance: manual-approx for travel-time purposes.

generatedNote: Edge distances/times: PV-5 measured (medium confidence) where available, else straight-line manual-approx. 30/47 edges measured.

routes.note: edge.route.waypoints run from edge.from to edge.to in game uu and include both zone anchors. A bidirectional edge is walked back along the reversed waypoints unless edge.routeReverse exists. Edge length/time are the route's; the earlier values are under edge.beforeRoute.
